scenes.say: Five minutes before you open can save you an hour of chaos.
Keep it to three things. What's eighty-sixed today. Who's on which station. And the one thing we're nailing this shift.

scenes.speaker: Ana
scenes.say: Before the huddle, I found out we were out of oat milk from a guest.

props.name: Ana
props.quote: I used to find out from *a guest*.

scenes.say: So: same time every shift, standing up, five minutes. Everyone talks once. And end on a thank you.
